project.name: @gitmars/monorepo
project.description: A Powerful Git Workflow CLI Tool that wraps complex git commands into user-friendly methods with built-in shell utilities, worktree integration, conflict pre-check, operation history, and repository health diagnostics. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
